selection: Seeded hash order and round-robin title-based subfields, one market per parent event. Only verified binary outcomes; actual conservative label timestamps inside Aug-Dec 2025; at least seven days of reported trading lifetime before closure. No selection on winner, volume or P&L.
independence: One per Gamma event and heuristic economic group. Asset-week price ladders, IPO/acquisition families and same-day Fed decisions are grouped across IDs. These rules do not establish statistical independence; common news and aliases remain.
wallet_scope: All wallet addresses returned in maker+taker feeds for selected markets. Not all platform wallets, lifetime histories, or skilled/unskilled labels.
